name: El Silencio Lodge & Spa
positioning: Relais & Châteaux lodge of suites and villas in a 500-acre cloud forest reserve beside the Poás Volcano, with waterfalls and trails on the property
best_for: Nature lovers who want waterfalls, trails and guided hikes on the property
Families or friends wanting a villa with its own deck and heated outdoor jet pool
Wellness travelers who want daily yoga and spa treatments in the forest

facts.text: El Silencio Lodge & Spa sits within a 500-acre natural reserve.
The lodge is in a secluded valley adjacent to the Poás Volcano.
The property is surrounded by five protected wildlife areas.
El Silencio Lodge & Spa is a member of Relais & Châteaux.
The lodge was awarded Two MICHELIN Keys in The MICHELIN Guide 2026, its second consecutive year with this distinction.
Deluxe Suites are terraced along the hillside for extra privacy, with mountain or forest views.
Rooms have vaulted ceilings of locally sourced wood and floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Three-Bedroom Villa has a full kitchen, a stacked stone fireplace and a deck with a heated outdoor jet pool.
The rate includes complimentary activities such as a yoga class, archery, the Mystic Hike, tree planting, mountain bike use and a farm visit.
Esencia Spa's Coffee Ritual pairs an orange and coffee exfoliation with a hot stones massage.
Las Ventanas Restaurant offers a fusion of Costa Rican, Peruvian and Mediterranean flavors.
An off-site hike leads to the base of the 290-foot Del Toro waterfall, which sinks into an extinct volcanic crater.

highlights.text: The property has three waterfalls and over 2 km of trails.
The Two-Bedroom Riverside Villas have a vast deck and two private outdoor heated whirlpools.
Samana Wellness Center is built across two levels with 180-degree views of the forest and river.
Each Deluxe Suite has a private viewing deck with handcrafted rocking chairs and a heated outdoor jacuzzi.
The on-site Adventure Park offers zip-lining and waterfall rappelling.

considerations.text: The lodge is about 90 minutes from Juan Santamaría International Airport.
The lodge recommends booking popular activities such as Arenal Volcano day trips, zip-lining and spa treatments in advance.
WhataHotel notes limited connectivity due to the secluded mountain setting.
